hotels.title: Stylish Hyde Johannesburg Rosebank Stay in the Heart of the City
hotels.description: Set in Johannesburg’s polished Rosebank precinct, this design-led retreat places you steps from Rosebank Mall, The Zone’s fashion boutiques and the much-loved Sunday Rosebank Art & Craft Market. Contemporary interiors blend clean lines with warm textures, creating a refined city base with a distinctly local sensibility. Mornings begin with coffee and breakfast at Proud Mary before gallery-hopping along nearby Keyes Art Mile or visiting Goodman Gallery. Back at the hotel, a rooftop pool offers elevated city views, while the in-house restaurant serves globally inspired plates alongside cocktails above the skyline
